component.name: Limoniter
component.summary: Text and hex editor that also reads older computers' files and disks

description.p: Limoniter is a text and hex editor for everyday work that also understands the files, character sets and disks of older computers.

ul.li: Text and code with highlighting for many languages, column mode, find and replace with regular expressions, comparison, and files of any size, read from disk as needed
Hex view and editing, with a string explorer and a character table
178 character sets, from ASCII and EBCDIC to PETSCII, the ZX Spectrum's and Teletext
Disk and tape images from the Spectrum, Commodore, Amiga, Atari, Apple, BBC Micro and more, opened as folders, with files added, renamed and deleted
BASIC programs listed and tokenised, pictures shown, and assembler source run on a built-in ZX Spectrum, an emulator or the real machine
SFTP, a terminal panel and scripting
